intent: Block selection and resistance share equal desk space. Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.
source:
**Frame:** Two labels share the desk: `THESIS SHAPES SELECTION` and `EVIDENCE CAN RESIST THESIS`. Neither wins the frame.

**Caption:**
> A STARTING BIAS DOES NOT MAKE EVERY CLAIM FALSE.
>
> HIDING IT WOULD MAKE THE CLAIMS HARDER TO EVALUATE.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — epistemic framing.
title: Selection and resistance share equal desk space
